dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Fantastic. No one's secretly trying to get rid of me, or trying to blow up Lumidouce Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: And people have stopped engaging in shady practices like bribery, fraud, or backstabbing.

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Peace has been restored to Lumidouce Harbor. Not bad!

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: And I played a big role in it all, too. Even better!
